name: She Already Has Someone She Likes?!
source:
“Every man has his secret sorrows which the world knows not; and oftentimes we call a man cold when he is only sad.”

Kawamura Shizuka is the type of girl who lies awake at 2 in the morning thinking about that time in 3rd grade she accidentally called her teacher 'mom'.

In stark contrast, Ishihara Mai is almost too sure of herself, exuding boundless confidence even when it's clear she's in the wrong.

Despite the night-and-day difference in their worldviews, these two have somehow managed to become the best of friends, something that Shizuka is (begrudgingly) okay with...

Until she finds out that the girl who she's always thought of out-of-her-league has a crush...on who, exactly? (seriously, would it kill her to be a little less vague?!)

Like, obviously, she was never planning on confessing in the first place!!! 

But now...it's almost like Mai's forcing her hand!

[From [url=https://studiochuunibyou.itch.io/she-already-has-someone-she-likes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“每个人都有他秘密的悲伤，而世人不知道；当一个人只是悲伤时，我们常常称他为冷漠。”

河村静香是那种凌晨两点就睡不着的女孩，她会想起三年级时她不小心叫老师“妈妈”的那次经历。

与此形成鲜明对比的是，石原麻衣几乎对自己过于自信，即使很明显自己错了，她仍流露出无限的自信。

尽管他们的世界观截然不同，但这两个人还是设法成为最好的朋友，静香（不情愿地）对此表示同意……

直到她发现那个她一直认为不合群的女孩爱上了……到底是谁？（说真的，如果她不那么含糊的话，她会死吗？！）显然，她一开始就没打算坦白！！！

但现在……就好像麻衣在强迫她动手一样！
